arxiv-1402.4677.text: Encoding complex graph-theoretic properties — such as reachability, shortest paths, maximum s-t flow, minimum spanning trees, and directed acyclic graph (DAG) acyclicity — directly into Boolean SAT or standard SMT bit-vector/integer theories causes severe formula blowup and poor solver propagation. MonoSAT introduces a general DPLL(T) framework for finite monotonic theories that integrates dedicated incremental graph algorithms directly inside an SMT solver.

arxiv-1402.4677.text: MonoSAT maintains dual under-approximating and over-approximating graphs as Boolean edge variables are assigned during Conflict-Driven Clause Learning (CDCL) search. When a graph predicate (such as reachability or cycle-freeness) becomes violated, MonoSAT extracts a succinct conflict clause (cut-set or witness path) in polynomial time, orders of magnitude faster than propositional encodings.

arxiv-2610.08739v2.text: We propose BARE-AI, a runtime framework that detects, localizes, and mitigates BFAs during inference. BARE-AI introduces AI Performance Counters (APCs), lightweight hardware monitors in the accelerator datapath that capture per-layer activation statistics such as sparsity, entropy, kurtosis, and spectral shift. These are analyzed by the Predictive Unit for Layer Security Evaluation (PULSE), a compact detector trained offline as an ensemble of classifiers and realized on-chip as a small neural engine.

arxiv-2610.08739v2.text: Synthesized at 28nm, the monitoring infrastructure incurs under 3% energy, under 4% area, and about 10% latency overhead, with a configurable operating point that reduces latency overhead to about 6%. arxiv-2610.33748.text: Fil-C retrofits spatial and temporal memory safety onto C and C++ programs using software capabilities (InvisiCaps) checked on every pointer dereference. However, Fil-C relies on an unstated hardware assumption that DRAM reliably preserves capability metadata. In Fil-C, each heap pointer's upper-bound word is stored inline in ordinary DRAM without hardware integrity protection.

arxiv-2610.33748.text: A single 0-to-1 bit-flip induced by Rowhammer in a pointer's upper-bound metadata expands the pointer's permitted memory range by 2^k bytes. Because the runtime treats the corrupted upper bound as authoritative, it silently permits out-of-bounds reads and writes without raising any panic, signal, or exception.

research-formal-verification-languages-i.text: In chip and semiconductor design, Formal Verification Languages provide the mathematical foundation for specifying and proving Register-Transfer Level (RTL) and architectural invariants before silicon fabrication. The industrial backbone comprises IEEE 1800 SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and IEEE 1850 Property Specification Language (PSL) for linear temporal logic (LTL) Formal Property Verification (FPV), complemented by multi-modal verification and hardware construction languages including UCLID5 (SMT-backed datapath/control modeling), Chisel/FIRRTL (ChiselFV), and Coq-embedded theorem-proving frameworks such as Kami.

research-sat-and-smt-solvers-application.text: Primary literature synthesized in this collection — MonoSAT: Modulo Theories for Graphs, Networks, and Geometry (arxiv-1402.4677); cvc5: A Versatile and Industrial-Strength SMT Solver (arxiv-2201.04663); A Survey of Symbolic Execution Techniques for Software Development and Verification (arxiv-1610.00502); SAT and SMT-Based Automated Reasoning for Description Logics and Formal Ontologies (arxiv-1507.01763) — spans three synergistic pillars: (1) **Software Development & Symbolic Execution** (KLEE, CBMC, Dafny, cvc5), where path constraints over bit-vectors and arrays synthesize bug-triggering inputs and prove memory-safety invariants; (2) **Graph Analysis Modulo Theories** (MonoSAT), where monotonic graph predicates (reachability, shortest path, maximum s-t flow, minimum spanning tree, and DAG acyclicity) are decided natively inside DPLL(T) without propositional blowup; and (3) **Ontology & Description Logic Reasoning** (OWL 2, EL/ALC, SHACL, OntoLogic), where TBox/ABox concept subsumption, consistency, and numerical datatype constraints reduce directly to Horn-SAT and SMT.
